scientific_integrity: Analytic proof separates all four sign cases and exact rational direct-payoff checks cover finite examples; empirical checks are not asserted as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two actions; positive side sizes; unit-weight complete bipartite graph; ties allowed; no dynamics, weights, stubborn players, or more actions. Independent scholarly audit not performed.
title: Exact parity and multiplicity of pure equilibria on mixed-type complete bipartite networks
